description:
FILES: apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/event_bus.ex, extensions/event_bus_demo.ex, test/octo_pi/coder/extension/event_bus_test.exs, test/octo_pi/coder/extensions/event_bus_demo_test.exs

CURRENT: event_bus.ex is a GenServer implementing pub/sub. api.events is a map %{emit: fn, on: fn} that wraps it. event_bus_demo.ex calls api.events.emit.(channel, data) and api.events.on.(channel, handler).

TARGET: Replace with Elixir's built-in Registry.

REGISTRY SETUP:
- Start Registry with keys: :duplicate and a session-scoped name (not a global atom -- multiple sessions must coexist). The name can be a via-tuple or passed as a pid.
- Subscribe: Registry.register(registry, channel, [])
- Publish: Registry.dispatch(registry, channel, fn entries -> Enum.each(entries, fn {pid, _} -> send(pid, {:custom_event, channel, payload}) end) end)
- Registry handles process cleanup automatically on subscriber crash/exit.

API.t() CHANGE: The events field type changes from %{emit: fn, on: fn} to a registry reference (pid or name tuple). Update the @type in api.ex accordingly.

event_bus_demo.ex CHANGE: Replace api.events.emit.(ch, data) with Registry.dispatch(...). Replace api.events.on.(ch, handler) with Registry.register(...) + a receive loop or handle_info in the calling process. Document the new pattern in the moduledoc.

NOTE: event_bus_demo is the ONLY extension using api.events. No other extension is affected.

DELETE event_bus.ex once Registry is wired in. Update application supervision tree if event_bus is started there.

TEST: Replace event_bus_test.exs tests with Registry-based equivalents. Update event_bus_demo_test.exs.
title: Replace EventBus GenServer with Registry
